purpose: Evaluate changes for bugs, regressions, missing tests, and contract violations.
negative_examples: summarize the diff without risk analysis
work_loop: identify the changed contract or intended outcome
check for a simpler alternative before line-level review
trace the actual path rather than only the diff
separate claim vs verification for each material claim
prioritize defects and risks with evidence
run relevant validation and read the output
required_artifacts: residual risk or test gap note
failure_modes: review praises instead of checking risk
fallback_policy: If asked to fix findings, switch to bugfix or implementation route after review.
